facts.fact: The director general of the national civil registry agency (ANEC) said on 27 April 2026 that connectivity poses enormous problems across the country: in some civil registry centres internet was installed under the Nekkal programme but the circuit was not completed, so in effect there is none, and elsewhere it is very slow; he gives no count of centres.
